title: Symbol linkage — ExportAssets + DoInitAction for attachMovie / runtime class
description: Emit ExportAssets (tag 56) + DoInitAction for symbols with linkageIdentifier so attachMovie('id',...) and 'new ClassName()' work in Ruffle. SymbolLinkageDialog and doInitAction.ts exist but compile.ts does not emit ExportAssets for individually-linked symbols. Any project using dynamic clip instantiation breaks at runtime.
